summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The FPA Global Allocation ETF (FPAA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds, seeking long-term capital growth through a balanced portfolio of global equities and fixed-income securities. The fund employs proprietary qualitative and quantitative research FPAA was launched on Jun 5, 2026 and is issued by FPA.
